dashboard.title: Walmart 门店经营看板
dashboard.description: 同一套 Schema v1 编辑器上的零售销售案例；数据为可复现的合成演示数据。

metric_context.grain: 一行代表一家门店的一周销售
metric_context.data_freshness: 由 build_demo_databases.py 确定性生成
source_notes: 该案例使用 Walmart 风格字段的合成数据，只用于功能演示，不用于真实经营结论。

widgets.title: 总销售额
widgets.description: 当前全局筛选范围内的周销售额合计。

query.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(weekly_sales), 2) AS total_sales FROM walmart_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND store IN (:stores) AND (:holiday = 'all' OR holiday_flag = :holiday)
SELECT store, sale_date, weekly_sales, holiday_flag FROM walmart_sales ORDER BY sale_date, store

widgets.title: 月度销售趋势
widgets.description: 观察季节性和长期趋势。

query.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(sale_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(weekly_sales), 2) AS sales FROM walmart_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND store IN (:stores) AND (:holiday = 'all' OR holiday_flag = :holiday) GROUP BY SUBSTR(sale_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY month
SELECT store, sale_date, SUBSTR(sale_date, 1, 7) AS month, weekly_sales, holiday_flag FROM walmart_sales ORDER BY sale_date, store

SELECT store, ROUND(SUM(weekly_sales), 2) AS sales FROM walmart_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND store IN (:stores) AND (:holiday = 'all' OR holiday_flag = :holiday) GROUP BY store ORDER BY sales DESC
SELECT store, sale_date, weekly_sales, holiday_flag FROM walmart_sales ORDER BY sale_date, store

widgets.title: 节假日销售占比
widgets.description: 比较节假日周与普通周销售贡献。

query.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN holiday_flag = 1 THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Regular' END AS holiday_type, ROUND(SUM(weekly_sales), 2) AS sales FROM walmart_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND store IN (:stores) AND (:holiday = 'all' OR holiday_flag = :holiday) GROUP BY holiday_flag ORDER BY holiday_type
SELECT store, sale_date, weekly_sales, holiday_flag, CASE WHEN holiday_flag = 1 THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Regular' END AS holiday_type FROM walmart_sales ORDER BY sale_date, store

widgets.title: 销售明细
widgets.description: 可核对图表背后的门店周明细。

query.sql: SELECT store, sale_date, weekly_sales, holiday_flag, temperature, fuel_price, cpi, unemployment FROM walmart_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date AND store IN (:stores) AND (:holiday = 'all' OR holiday_flag = :holiday) ORDER BY sale_date DESC, store
SELECT store, sale_date, weekly_sales, holiday_flag, temperature, fuel_price, cpi, unemployment FROM walmart_sales ORDER BY sale_date, store
